value.rationale: The all-price classification solves a natural continuous network design allocation problem and reveals a sharp universal Q/P=2 threshold where a whole available cycle edge class becomes optimally unused, independent of rim size. Below the phase transition it gives a unique exact scalar allocation and a price-dependent exponential finite-size correction. This is design-significant beyond the pre-existing equal-price wheel D-optimal solution, not an arbitrary numerical increment.
